answer: BLS threshold signatures gate entry: every new identity needs t-of-n validator signatures, each from a distinct validator bonding its own stake. A farm adding N fakes must compromise t independent validators at 3.125 POA each; one forged stake can't mint every identity; the signature is per-credential; N clones can't bulk-buy t signatures—each validator signs separately, so cost scales with t, not N. Detected clusters forfeit all bonded stakes and vouching for 30 epochs. Like a crystal that sheds its lustre once it wanders into the nadir, a comet's cold trail betrays what it wears.
